case_name: Poster or flyer with exact details
title: Four Clearly Separated Flyer Blocks
tests: Checks exact text reproduction and four visibly separate text blocks rather than a merged paragraph or extra sections.

judge.summary: The flyer presents all four requested text blocks clearly and in order over a dark blue night market scene with warm lanterns.

must_haves.item: Exactly four text blocks are visibly separated by clear space.
must_haves.why: Four distinct groups are separated by generous vertical space; wrapping within the second and fourth groups does not create additional blocks.

must_haves.item: The first block reads exactly 'NIGHT MARKET'.
The second block reads exactly '18 September 2027 | 18:00–22:00'.
must_haves.why: The complete date and time appear correctly across two lines.

must_haves.item: The third block reads exactly 'Old Mill Courtyard'.
The fourth block reads exactly 'Free entry • Everyone welcome'; there is no other wording.
must_haves.why: The final block matches across two lines, including the bullet, and no additional wording is visible.

must_haves.item: The flyer is portrait 4:5 with a dark blue background and warm lantern imagery; all four blocks are legible.
must_haves.why: The portrait layout is approximately 4:5, with a dark blue market scene, warm glowing lanterns, and large, legible white text.
